info.title: Wax or Hearing Loss?
info.subtitle: How to tell, and when to get help.

rows.title: Sudden and one-sided
rows.desc: Wax often blocks one ear overnight

rows.title: Skip the cotton swabs
rows.desc: They push wax into a firm plug

rows.title: Soften, then rinse
rows.desc: Drops loosen mild buildup over days

rows.title: Test if it lingers
rows.desc: Muffling that stays needs a hearing test
